programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.sub-title: Show Me Some Whitetail in Missouri
programme.desc: On this episode of North American Whitetail, Dale Evans makes a late-season return to the Show Me State. Finally, we close with a Big Buck Profile with Haynes Shelton looking at the Corey Welford buck.

programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.sub-title: Stan Potts Gets It Done Again in Illinois
programme.desc: This week on North American Whitetail, Stan Potts pulls out his crossbow to show us how it is done in his home state of Illinois. During Dr. Deer, we look at how Dr. Kroll comes up with his battle plan before he heads out to the woods. In From the Stand, Blake Garlock looks at Browning's new line of cellular trail cameras. Finally, Haynes looks at a pair of amazing sheds from the Iowa Deer Classic.
